Hey, another doujin translated! Can you believe this one hasn’t been translated since 2022? That’s ages ago!. Anyway, this one’s way shorter than the other doujins I’ve translated, so fixing mistakes was pretty quick and easy. But as always, if you spot any errors, just let me know and I’ll fix them.

Here’s the original RAW: https://e-hentai.org/g/2251375/81c7ccec24/ (uploaded by bandmaster88).
